Game Overview

In Reverse Fall, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a quirky adventure in Reverse Fall, where you play as an apple battling Sir Isaac Newton's clone army. Navigate with touch controls, dodge rainbow beams, and defy gravity in a whimsical alternate 1600s reality. Hone your reflexes to master increasingly wild and thrilling challenges.
